## Change / 改动

Describe a registration implementation, listing correction, trust-boundary change, withdrawal, tooling update, or documentation change.
说明登记实现、条目修正、信任边界变更、撤回、工具或文档改动。

Routine plugin releases belong in the publisher repository and must not be added here.
常规插件版本属于开发者仓库，不应在此登记。

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] One product entry contains no release history or artifacts / 单一产品条目不包含发行历史或安装包
- [ ] Product ID and every host package ID are preserved / 产品 ID 及各宿主包 ID 均得到保留
- [ ] Source identity checks preserved; permissions remain host-owned / 保留来源身份校验，权限由宿主负责
- [ ] Repository references remain bilingual; public guide changes go to the docs site / 仓库参考保持双语，公开指南改到文档站
- [ ] Unit tests, directory/API/site validation, and diff check pass / 单测、目录/API/站点校验与差异检查通过
